focus: Confirm-mode assets deep-research-confirm.yaml and deep-review-confirm.yaml: test each auto-twin defect against them, then report confirm-unique defects

graphEvents.label: Do the auto-twin executor-gate defects carry into the confirm assets?
deep-research-confirm.yaml gates on config.executor.type; canonical field is kind
No if_cli_<kind> branch for the kind the live config selects
--pure hardcoded opencode with unguarded model in both confirm files

label: deep-research-confirm.yaml gates executor dispatch on config.executor.type at lines 1177, 1183, 1362 and 1366, but the canonical config field is kind: the live run config's executor object has keys [kind, model, reasoningEffort, sandboxMode, serviceTier, timeoutSeconds] with no type, and the twin deep-review-confirm.yaml gates on .kind at 1304, 1310, 1499, 1503. skip_when never matches for native and branch_on resolves to no branch key, so the iteration dispatch node selects nothing and raises nothing.

Both confirm files enumerate exactly four dispatch branches (if_native, if_cli_copilot, if_cli_claude_code, if_cli_opencode) and no if_cli_<other kind> branch, so the kind the live config selects (cli-pi) has no branch and no terminal if_else/if_unknown fail-loud branch: which kinds dispatch externally and which silently fall back to native is undeterminable from the contract.

deep-research-confirm.yaml:1259 and deep-review-confirm.yaml:1386 are the same argv line passing --pure to a hardcoded 'opencode' command (research-confirm:1275) while model is interpolated unguarded at 1247 even though reasoningEffort one line earlier is guarded against the 'null' literal, so a null model reaches argv as the string null.

The carried 'lock acquired without --owner-pid' defect is refuted: resolveOwnerPid returns process.pid and acquire marks the lock ownerKind 'transient' by design. The real confirm-specific defect is that a transient lock is stale at twice its 1800000ms TTL (sixty minutes) while the only refresh is step_refresh_lock at the top of phase_loop, after the unbounded interactive approval gates, and the file declines to ask before reclaiming, so a second run can open the same packet while the first is still live.

deep-research-confirm.yaml both appends spec_synthesis_deferred with reason confirm_mode_deferred_writeback at 1735 and performs the ordinary post-synthesis spec_mutation writeback at 1757, with no condition stated that routes to either, so an operator cannot tell whether confirm mode leaves findings in spec.md; the auto twin has only the conditional 'when synthesis cannot safely write back' form at 2287.

The bare {generation} token persists in both confirm files and deep-research-confirm.yaml splits between it (line 183 synthesis_snapshot_pattern, 340, 350) and the qualified {config.lineage.generation} used by every state-log event, so if the bare token renders empty the first synthesis writes synthesis-v.md and later generations overwrite it, collapsing lineage generations on disk.

deep-research-confirm.yaml's confirm_parity block (1915-1933) is the cluster's only stated auto/confirm gap - eleven censused omissions plus gateway_wiring.auto_only_sites - and it answers the missing-step question for research, but nothing enforces it and deep-review-confirm.yaml has no confirm_parity block at all; extension: generate the block by diffing step_* ids across each auto/confirm pair and failing when an auto id is neither present nor censused.
A config-derived field interpolated into argv must be guarded against the null-literal string, or the executor receives the string null as a value.
Both confirm assets are dated Oct 28 while both auto twins are dated Nov 7, so the confirm surfaces are ten days stale against the contract they are supposed to mirror.

direction: Lock acquired without --owner-pid is an ownership defect
reason: loop-lock.cjs resolveOwnerPid returns process.pid when the flag is absent and acquire then marks lockData.ownerKind 'transient' so the lock expires on heartbeat age instead of pid liveness; on_acquire captures ownerPid and acquireNonce and reuses both for refresh and release, so the chain is coherent by design.

direction: A normaliser maps executor.kind onto executor.type before branch_on evaluates
reason: The live config carries only kind and the twin review-confirm gates on kind; no mapping is present in the two dispatch blocks read, so deep-research-confirm.yaml's .type predicate has nothing to resolve against.
